description: Check a US customs broker against U.S. Customs and Border Protection's official Permitted Customs Broker Listing: filer code, broker name, city, state, work phone and e-mail where CBP lists them. Search by name, by 3-character filer code, or list a state. A broker missing from the list holds no national permit on CBP's page; individual licence numbers are not published there. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

q.description: Part of the broker name, or a 3-character filer code such as 92K

state.description: Optional two-letter US state, e.g. TX
